chunks: 5014 - Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“A man was brought to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام after he was found beneath a man’s bed, so Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ordered concerning him that he be smeared in a latrine.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.تَحْتَ فِرَاشِ رَجُلٍ: beneath a man’s bed; the compromising circumstance described in the report
key_terms.فَلُوِّثَ: he was smeared or soiled as a form of disciplinary humiliation
key_terms.مَخْرُأَةٍ: a latrine or foul place associated with excrement

ai.seo_question: What punishment did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام order for a man found beneath another man’s bed?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a case brought before Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام involving a man found beneath another man’s bed, and it describes a discretionary punitive measure imposed upon him. The report falls within the legal discussion of taʿzīr-style punishments for acts warranting disciplinary action short of the fixed hadd penalties.
